Winter War Event 2/9 - 3/9 Quickly build and expand your city during the Winter War event! The Soviet Union expected a quick victory when they invaded Finland in November 1939. They had significant infantry superiority, and their thousands of planes and tanks could be met by only a few dozen on the Finnish side. With sympathy but no real military aid from abroad, the Finns set up defenses along two fronts. One was the northern hinterlands whose forests were well suited for a guerrilla campaign. Battery Level Resource Requirements Upgrade Time Citizens Req’d XP DMG Re-arm Cost 16 9,000,000 Gold 3d 2 750 11,878 33,300 17 10,000,000 Gold 3d 2 750 12,087 33,600 18 11,000,000 Gold 3d 2 750 12,296 33,900 19 12,000,000 Gold 3d 2 750 12,505 34,200 20 13,000,000 Gold 4d 2 750 12,714 34,500 21 14,000,000 Gold 4d 2 750 12,923 34,800 22 15,000,000 Gold 4d 2 750 13,132 35,100 23 16,000,000 Gold 5d 2 750 13,341 35,400 24 17,000,000 Gold 5d 2 750 13,550 35,700 25 18,000,000 Gold 5d 2 750 13,759 36,000 Quality of Life Updates Donate Troops Without Training Sometimes your Alliance mates will have a Troop Request that you have the resources to fill, but it requires you to dump your current Troop composition to make room and train new Troops for the request. You shouldn’t have to spend twice the resources to help fellow Alliance members. If you already have the means to assist, now you will be able to do so! In Update 13.3, you can directly donate Troops to requests, provided you can train them yourself. This is part of our ‘Tap less, play more’ philosophy, and as an added benefit, the Troop Donation UI is more straightforward. Troop Donation Capacity Update We’re removing the Troop limit of 20, so if you want to donate the maximum amount of Troop Donation space with only Heavy Infantry, you can do that. This allows for one player to fill an entire Troop Donation request alone, with no limits outside of the Alliance Troop Donation cap of the receiving player. A specific issue with Troop Donations is a recurring topic we’ve covered in earlier forum posts. However, to recap, players would sometimes receive Troop Donations mid-battle for a request that still had room for donation. After the battle, the player would see a remaining total of Troops that filled their original request, and they would be unable to make a new request until these were used. This resulted in players often reporting that they didn’t receive Troops or their Troop Donation disappeared. We believe that making it easier to fulfill a Troop Donation will help with CS reporting should any issues arise. Alliance Speed Up Assistance Improvements All active Alliance Speed Up Requests in your Alliance chat can now be assisted with a single tap in update 13.3. Claim National Trade Goods Button Update 13.3 introduces a new button at the Embassy that lets you claim all your National Trade Goods from your inventory and place them directly in your storehouse, up to the storage limit. Additionally, NTG Shipments and the NTG Chests are also automatically opened, putting all their contents into your inventory! New Commander Cosmetics The Miner cosmetic for Ripley is currently in development, and we'll slowly be introducing seven more shaders at a later date! New Councilors & Artifacts New Legendary & Mythical Artifacts We’ll be adding two new Legendary Artifacts to 13.3 with their Mythical Counterparts to release at a later date. The Analytical Engine will assist the defender's play style with stats focused on Towers, Catapults, and spawning defenders. You'll be able to start collecting this Legendary Artifact in March! anniv9.text: DomiNations 9th Anniversary Celebrate 9 years of DomiNations! Mar 28, 2024 - by DomiNations Greetings Leaders, Our 9th Anniversary Celebration is almost upon us! It’s that special time when we celebrate DomiNations and all of you playing over the last year. To show our appreciation for your continued support, we’ll have tons of rewards for you to claim, faster progression with instant building upgrades, and resource boosts. There’s even a special 9th Anniversary Community War with prizes for the Top 10 Alliances! Between 4/1 and 5/31 you’ll have plenty to do as you collect 9th Anniversary Chests with chances at Legendary Artifacts. Our social pages will be featuring more giveaways and our BHG Merch store returns! There are even brand new Legendary Artifacts that will be released throughout the Anniversary period. Celebrate the 9th Anniversary Instant Building Upgrades From 4/1 to 5/31 we’ll be rotating instant upgrades for specific buildings. The buildings to see instant upgrades will rotate between Library, Roads, Temple, Caravans, Archive, Farms, University, Vault, and Oil Well. 99% Resource boost every weekend! Fill out and replenish your Gold, Food, and Oil reserves every weekend to support your instant upgrade progression. A Special Anniversary War Chest During the Anniversary period (4/1 - 5/31) War Chests given after participating in World Wars will have chances at valuable Speed Ups, Bazooka Tower, B-17 Hangar, Legendary Recruitments, and so much more! 9th Anniversary Event Chest You’ll find this chest as a reward through various activities during the Anniversary celebrations! This chest features chances at some of the latest Legendary Artifacts including the Maori War Club, Li Vessel, Creighton Abrams Tank Commander Kit, and the Leoni Parade Shield. Council Celebration A Daily 80% discount on Premium and Superior Recruitments! Anniversary Special Pass 4/1 - 4/8 The first 9th Anniversary Event pass begins with a Free 9th Anniversary Chest. The free tier will also include Crowns, Speed Ups, a Tank Workshop, and even a Legendary Token. Picking up the Premium Pass you’ll find 9x 9th Anniversary Chests, 5 stacks of 999x Crowns, 9x Legendary Tokens, a Power Plant, and more! Daily Rewards 4/1 - 4/14 You’ll want to log in daily to claim FREE rewards! Some highlights include a 9th Anniversary Chest to kick off the Anniversary Event on 4/1, grab 9x free Legendary Tokens on 4/9, and finish the daily rewards with 99x Crowns on 4/14! There are even Troop Tactics, Speed Ups, and more each day that you won’t want to miss! Social Giveaways Join us on our social channels as we run giveaways for the entire two-month celebration! Don’t miss out on a chance to win extra Crowns, Anniversary Chests, and even a bundle of Legendary Tokens from another Legendary Lottery leading up to Marco’s Legendary Vault in May! Stay tuned on Facebook , X , or Instagram ! 9th Anniversary Community War Challenge! Starting 5/2 10am EST - 5/31 10am EST we’ll be running a special Community War Challenge! The competition will be run in a Ladder style format where you’ll continue to compete as much or as little as you and your Alliance would like. Victories in Custom War will see you climbing to the top, and get you ever closer to the rewards for the Top 10 Alliances! Placing within the Top 10 will get you 9x 9th Anniversary Chests for each Alliance member. The first place Alliance will also receive 9x Legendary Tokens! Come back 4/24 for full participation details. We look forward to seeing the results of the competition! Good luck, and may the best Alliance Win! Artifacts Three brand new Legendary Artifacts will be released during the 9th Anniversary! Two War Hall Artifacts and one Main Hall Artifact, the first of which releases 4/1. We’ll reveal the first one today, but you’ll have to come back on 4/14 and 5/5 for the reveal of the next two. We certainly won’t leave you empty-handed though, you can have a sneak peek in the meantime at what’s to come! Stock Up On DomiNations Merch Be among the first to grab our DomiNations apparel and accessories; we’ll be launching our new Merch Store on 4/9! More information to come on our social channels and DomiNationsWorld.com From all of us here at Big Huge Games, thank you for another exciting year of DomiNations! Upgrading to the Premium Pass will net you the Kamov Ka-50 Army, F-15 STOL, Recon Plane, and a Helipad! Events Veterans Day Event 11/3 - 12/1 This week begins our Veterans Day Event! In 1945, World War II veteran Raymond Weeks from Birmingham, Alabama, had the idea to expand Armistice Day to celebrate all veterans, not just those who died in World War I. Weeks led a delegation to Gen. Dwight Eisenhower, who supported the idea of National Veterans Day. U.S. representative Ed Rees from Emporia, Kansas, presented a bill establishing the holiday through Congress. President Dwight D. Eisenhower, also from Kansas, signed the bill into law on May 26, 1954. Because it is a federal holiday, some American workers and many students have Veterans Day off from work or school. Legally, two minutes of silence is recommended to be observed at 2:11pm Eastern Standard Time. Enjoy these discounts for a limited time! 33% off the following General upgrades: Cleopatra Churchill Joan of Arc MacArthur Napoleon Petra Herrera Sun Tzu Zhukov King Tut’s Tomb Event 11/4 - 11/11 In 1922, archaeologist Howard Carter discovered the entrance to the tomb of the Egyptian pharaoh Tutankhamun in the Valley of the Kings. The tomb had been lost for centuries, preserving a massive trove of ancient artifacts. Along with the famous funerary mask and solid gold coffin, Carter’s team found thrones, weapons, musical instruments, jewelry, an alabaster chalice, and a dagger made of meteoric iron. This massive collection of artifacts still travels the world as a museum exhibition and has ensured King Tut’s place in history! Leveling Up Museum Artifacts costs 20% less Blueprints and 20% less resources for a limited time! Mythical Artifact 11/3 - 11/17 This week, we’ll have the Mythical ASDIC Type 113X available in a step-up sale for Crowns. Each step gives you a chest with a chance to obtain this Mythical Artifact. Completing all steps in the sale will see you collecting it guaranteed! Invading Generals HP -14% Invading Barracks Troop DMG -14% Invading Factory Troop DMG -14% Invading Airstrip Troop DMG -14% Defender Spawn Time -14% Missile Silo DMG +14% Actions Against Cheating/Exploits Over the last month, we have banned 1,795 players , thanks to your help in reporting possible cheating and players exploiting the game. This significant increase was driven by our enhanced security efforts, which were prompted by the DDoS attack on our servers earlier this month, and we’re still refining them. Many of these were caused by the influx of new accounts resulting from the DDoS, but it also helped us expand our security measures even further and become more effective.
